Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

It’s time to unveil the latest additions to Marvel Future Fight in our v3.7 update! This new update brings two new characters as well as a host of quality of life improvements! Let’s take a look at what the next update will bring.

■Two New Characters

Adam Warlock and X-23 have been added to Future Fight.



*X-23 is available from the Processor, Premium Hero Chest, Event Battle and Character related Sales Package.
*Adam Warlock is a Native Tier-2 Character who is available via a package in Shop.
*Adam Warlock is a Native Tier-2 Character. He uses the same growth system as Worldboss.

[Event Battle]
This special stage will only be open during certain periods. Much like timeline battles, you will choose 3 characters to fight against a selected enemy team. If you participate, you will be given various rewards including X-23 X-Genes.
※ More information will be added once a fixed schedule has been decided

Along with new Characters, New Team Bonuses and New Challenges have been added.

■Three New Uniforms

New uniforms for Falcon, the Punisher and Satana have been added.

* Punisher – Marvel Legacy has different price point and upgrade material requirements with higher stats compared to other Marvel Legacy Uniform.
* New Uniforms will be on sale for a selected period. You will be able to check those in Marvel Universe / Uniform Room in the Shop.

■Dimension Rift Improvements

We have made some improvements to Dimension Rifts to ease their usage.


1. Dimension Rift refresh button has been added!

A new button has been added to the Dimension Rift window. You can now refresh your list of Dimension Rifts inside the Dimension Rift menu!



2. More ways to invite people!

When you open a dimension rift, a new notification will be added to the chat window allowing your friends and Alliance members to join instantly!



■ Character Management Improvements

1. More Stats added!

You can now see the number of characters and Uniforms you have at each rank and tier on the Hero Stats window!



2. Native Tier-2 Biometric Leveling improvements

When you are leveling up your native Tier-2 characters, the biometrics are now organised by the amount of biometrics you have. This will help you to level up your characters easier.



By tapping the question mark on the character portraits on this menu, you will be current equipment and status of the character, allowing you to make the right choice when you use their biometrics.


■Other Changes

1. X-Genes now available in Lab > Processor

※ Processing X-Genes in Processor cannot produce Magneto, and Native Tier-2 X-Gene Characters.

2. Characters which cannot be selected in the Selector: Biometrics and Selector: X-Gene will now show where they can be acquired.



3. Cards set will now display which cards are missing from the set.


4. When using filters and the sort functions in the card menu, the game will now remember your previous sorting criteria instead of resetting each time.

5. New chat notifications have been added when acquiring characters or items of certain ranks.

6. Library has been updated. It is now sorted vertically rather than horizontally

7. Some icons on the main menu have been modified.

8. When using quick enhance multiple times, your selected materials will be remembered.

9. You can now select 6★ ISO-8 in the ISO-8 quick upgrade menu

10. Fixed an issue with sorting ISO-8’s after upgrading them where they did not sort as intended.

11. Cooldown Time for ISO-8 Set Effect now will be shown.
